original:
Hey there! I'll be arriving in Paris on November 15th to stay for a day with a total budget of 500 euros for the trip. Can you recommend a restaurant that serves authentic French cuisine? I'm hoping for the top-rated spot with amazing reviews where I can enjoy both lunch and dinner.
I'm also in need of a highly-rated hotel in Paris that fits the budget (assuming two meals) based on its minimum price. Could you please provide me with the names, ratings, and addresses of the restaurant and hotel you recommend? Thank you so much!
text:
Habari! Nitawasili Paris mnamo Novemba 15 kukaa kwa siku moja nikiwa na bajeti ya jumla ya 500 euros kwa safari hiyo. Je, unaweza kupendekeza mgahawa unaotoa vyakula halisi vya Kifaransa? Ninatarajia sehemu yenye alama za juu zaidi na maoni mazuri sana ambapo ninaweza kupata chakula cha mchana na cha jioni pia.
Pia ninahitaji hoteli yenye alama za juu mjini Paris inayolingana na bajeti (kwa kukadiria milo miwili) kulingana na bei yake ya chini zaidi. Tafadhali unaweza kunipatia majina, alama za tathmini, na anwani za mgahawa na hoteli unazopendekeza? Asante sana!
back_translation:
Hello! I will be arriving in Paris on November 15 to stay for one day, with an overall budget of 500 euros for the trip. Could you recommend a restaurant that offers authentic French cuisine? I'm looking for a place with the highest ratings and very good reviews where I can have both lunch and dinner.

I also need a highly rated hotel in Paris that fits the budget (after accounting for the two meals), based on its lowest price. Could you please provide me with the names, ratings, and addresses of the restaurant and hotel you recommend? Thank you very much!

original: Hey there! I'm going to Tokyo next week. Can you do me a favor and tell me the address, rating and minimum price for 'City Hub'? If it's rated over 4 and the price is under 200, please add an event to my calendar on January 2nd 2025 to remind me about reserving the hotel? Use the hotel name as the title and its address as the location. I'll book a room later. Thanks a lot!
text: Habari! Ninasafiri kwenda Tokyo wiki ijayo. Unaweza kunisaidia na kuniambia anwani, ukadiriaji na bei ya chini zaidi ya 'City Hub'? Ikiwa ina ukadiriaji wa zaidi ya 4 na bei ni chini ya 200, tafadhali niongezee tukio kwenye kalenda yangu tarehe 2 Januari 2025 la kunikumbusha kuweka nafasi ya hoteli? Tumia jina la hoteli kama kichwa cha tukio na anwani yake kama eneo. Nitahifadhi chumba baadaye. Asante sana!
back_translation: Hello! I'm traveling to Tokyo next week. Can you help me and tell me the address, rating, and lowest price of 'City Hub'? If it has a rating above 4 and the price is under 200, please add an event to my calendar on January 2, 2025 to remind me to book the hotel? Use the hotel name as the event title and its address as the location. I'll book the room later. Thank you very much!

back_translation:

For my cousin's family, recommend the top-rated car rental company that have SUVs available.

text: የእኔ ቤተሰብ እና የአጎቴ ልጅ ቤተሰብ ሎስ አንጀለስን ለ 3 ቀናት ለመጎብኘት አቅደናል። ለ 3 ቀናት ሁለት መኪኖችን መከራየት እንፈልጋለን። የኤሌክትሪክ መኪኖችን የሚያከራዩ የመኪና አከራይ ኩባንያዎችን ልትፈልግልኝ ትችላለህ? ከሁሉ የተሻለ ደረጃ የተሰጠውን የመኪና አከራይ ኩባንያ ጠቁመኝ። ለአጎቴ ልጅ ቤተሰብ ደግሞ SUVs ያላቸውን ከፍተኛ ደረጃ የተሰጠውን የመኪና አከራይ ኩባንያ ጠቁማቸው። የሁለቱን የመኪና አከራይ ኩባንያዎች ስም እና ደረጃቸውን፣ እንዲሁም ለእያንዳንዳቸው ለ 3 ቀናት ምን ያህል እንደሚያስወጣ ንገረኝ።
back_translation: My family and my cousin's family are planning to visit Los Angeles for 3 days. We would like to rent two cars for 3 days. Can you find me car rental companies that rent electric cars? Point me to the car rental company with the best rating. For my cousin's family, point them to the top-rated car rental company that has SUVs. Tell me the names and ratings of the two car rental companies, as well as how much it would cost for each for 3 days.
